descriptionEn:
Apartment for sale with an area of 64.2 m², located on Rruga Hajrullah Zymi, Fushë Kosovë.
Built by Aron Bau Residence.
Facing west, it has the following layout of interior spaces: living room, kitchen, one bedroom, one bathroom, one storage room and one balcony.
It is located on the 7th floor.
The contract is signed at the notary.
The heating system is electric underfloor heating.
The apartment is located in a developed area, close to public and private services.
